recognize_zh: 胸椎矢狀面 STIR 影像：脂肪訊號被抑制後，後方棘突與部分椎體出現斑片狀高訊號（骨髓水腫/腫瘤活動區），與周圍較暗的正常骨髓對比明顯，符合骨髓瘤侵犯。
features: Sagittal STIR (fat-suppressed fluid-sensitive) MRI of the thoracic spine
Patchy hyperintense signal within multiple spinous processes and posterior elements
Heterogeneous, mildly hyperintense foci within several vertebral bodies
Spinal cord and CSF well visualized without obvious intrinsic cord signal abnormality on this slice
Vertebral body heights largely preserved on this slice
describe_en: Sagittal STIR MRI of the thoracic spine demonstrates patchy hyperintense signal within multiple spinous processes and posterior elements, together with heterogeneous foci of increased signal in several vertebral bodies, reflecting marrow edema and active marrow infiltration. The spinal cord is visualized without obvious intrinsic signal change on this slice. When correlated with diffuse T1 hypointensity on companion images, the findings are consistent with multifocal myelomatous involvement of the spine.

ddx.vs: Metastases produce similar STIR-bright lesions, and separation relies on clinical history, M-protein studies and tissue biopsy rather than signal characteristics.
Benign fractures show band-like edema parallel to the endplate with preserved posterior elements, whereas this case shows multifocal posterior element and spinous process involvement.
Infection centers on the intervertebral disc with disc hyperintensity and endplate erosion across adjacent vertebrae, not on spinous processes with spared discs.
